jobs.description:
As a Senior Gameplay Engineer at Embark, you will work on ARC Raiders, alongside some of the most talented people in the games industry. We believe that great games are made in creative environments, where builds are always playable, and teams can move fast and test as many ideas as possible. In close collaboration with our designers, you will create easy-to-use systems that enable us to iterate quickly and that encourage experimentation. 
The games we're making are built in Unreal, using C++, blueprints and a scripting language called Angelscript. This is a technical, systems-oriented role rather than a content-facing one. You will work autonomously across problems like performance, tooling, architecture and networking - the systems our gameplay and design teams build on top of. You won't be planned for gameplay tasks by production; instead you're expected, with some direction, to find and explore solutions to our everyday and long-term technical problems.
Example of responsibilities

Collaborate with a wide range of talents at Embark to deliver ground-breaking technical solutions to create fun gameplay for our players

Identify and build tech to further increase the productivity of our daily work

Assist our team in debugging and fixing complex issues

Take ownership of technical systems across multiple areas of the game - often systems players never interact with directly, but that make everything else possible 

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

A strong background in C++

A good grasp of what good gameplay looks and feels like

Fluent in English - our team comes from all over the world!

An interest in computer science and programming as a craft

Experience working across multiple gameplay or engine systems, rather than deep specialization in a single narrow area 

Additionally one or some of these would be a great bonus

Experience with multiplayer

Previously worked with shooter or third-person games

Comfortable owning technical problems end-to-end with minimal day-to-day direction from design or production 

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

jobs.occupation: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer!
jobs.description:
Ready to shape and scale modern cloud infrastructure in an engineering-driven environment? Join a global tech team in Stockholm working at the forefront of cyber intelligence, cloud automation, and high-volume data processing. In this role, you will leverage Infrastructure as Code, AWS, and modern tools like the HashiCorp ecosystem to build, secure, and evolve scalable backend environments. Apply today as we use ongoing selection.
About the role
Our client is a well-established, technology-driven organization where deep engineering is at the heart of what they build. From a proprietary search engine to advanced cybersecurity solutions, their products are built to handle massive amounts of data and deliver actionable insights in real time. Their R&D, engineering, and data centers are located in Sweden, headquarters in London, and teams across the US, the company operates on a truly global scale.
Together with our client, we are looking for a driven DevOps Engineer to strengthen their team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining, automating, and scaling cloud and hybrid infrastructure strictly through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. You will work in an environment heavily centered around AWS and the HashiCorp ecosystem, specifically utilizing Nomad for workload orchestration and Vault for secrets management.
Work tasks
Drive the build-out of a cloud (AWS) version of the platform, working alongside the existing on-prem infrastructure.  
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale using Terraform.  
Manage orchestration and security using HashiCorp Nomad and Vault.  
Automate configuration management and provisioning with Ansible.  
Drive continuous security improvements.  
Use modern AI tooling to streamline infrastructure workflows and support development teams' day-to-day work.

We are looking for
Previous experience as a DevOps Engineer
Practical knowledge of the HashiCorp ecosystem, specifically Nomad and Vault and Consul.
Experience managing both AWS cloud environments 
Proficiency in Ansible.
Advanced understanding of infrastructure-level security.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Join Telavox as a Security Engineer 🔐
Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.
Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.
We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.
About the job
As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.
You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.
Your day-to-day work includes:

Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD

Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build

Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed

Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed

Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution

Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest

The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.
You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.
You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.
We are looking for someone with:

A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed

At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role

Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation

Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt

A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency

Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work

A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback

Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus

Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.

Platform Team Lead
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
The Role:
The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.

With your help, we want to:
- Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
- Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
- Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.

Who you are
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
- Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
- Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
- A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
- A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
- Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:
- At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
- A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
- The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
- Fluency in English.
- Swedish or German skills are a plus.

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
- Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
- Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
- Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.

What you will do:
You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
- Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
- Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
- Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
- Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
- Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.

What we offer:
- The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
- Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
- Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
- A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
- Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
- Mental health & parental support offerings
- 30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
- Deutschlandticket
- Wellpass

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
- 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
- Private pension savings

About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

 We are looking for an FPGA Developer within the Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN Compute products. You will contribute to the FPGA team by developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions.
